name: tipstreak
description: Tip your favorite creators in USDC on Solana Mobile — weekly streaks, loyalty badges, on-chain verified tips.

paragraphs: Support your favorite creators in USDC, straight from wallet to wallet — and grow your streak.

TipStreak is a Solana mobile app (Android, Solana Mobile Wallet Adapter) for tipping creators: music, dev, art, gaming, crypto… Fans send tips in USDC with no middleman, and loyalty is rewarded with weekly badges. Creators publish their page by signing with their wallet and receive tips directly on it.
Built for the Solana Mobile hackathon. Runs on Solana devnet. 📲 Download the Android APK: TipStreak (preview) on EAS · 🎬 First real tip, verified on-chain: view on Solana Explorer
features: Discover: creator list, search by name or handle, filters generated from the real categories.
USDC tips: quick or custom amounts, optional message signed inside the transaction (Memo program).
SKR boost (optional): add 5 SKR for the creator to pin your tip at the top of their wall for 7 days.
The USDC tip and the SKR boost go in one transaction: a single wallet approval, all or nothing.
My support: creators you support, streak (consecutive weeks), total given.
